age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from Solana

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

blockers.description: Blocking codes: `pay_to_not_wallet`, `pay_to_ata_missing`, `destination_ata_occupied`, and each applicable payer readiness blocker prefixed `payer_`

readiness.description: Transfer readiness of `payer` sending the amount to `pay_to`: what `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness` answers for the same transfer, without its `meta`

amount.description: Amount checked, in the asset's UI units (as sent)

amount_raw.description: Amount in raw units (lamports for SOL)

ata_creation_lamports.description: Lamports to create the destination token account: its rent-exempt minimum, or only the shortfall when its address already holds SOL; null when not needed

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset (9 for SOL)

destination_kind.description: Class of the destination account: not_found, wallet, nonce, token_account, mint, token_multisig, program, stake, vote or other

interest_rate_bps.description: InterestBearingConfig current rate in basis points; null without that extension

net_amount.description: Raw units the destination receives after any transfer fee

requires_ata_creation.description: True when the destination has no associated token account yet

token_program.description: Token program that owns the mint; null for SOL

transfer_fee.description: Token-2022 transfer fee in raw units; null without a fee config

transfer_fee_next.description: Newer transfer fee when its epoch is after the current epoch; null otherwise

ui_multiplier.description: ScaledUiAmount multiplier in effect at response time as a plain decimal string (display only, never used in amount math); null without ScaledUiAmount

verdict.description: `block` on any blocker, `warn` with warnings only, else `ok`

warnings.description: Non-blocking codes: `asset_not_canonical`, `pay_to_program_owned`, and payer readiness warnings prefixed `payer_`

description: Can this payer settle this x402 payment requirement right now? When to use: After an x402 server answered 402 with a Solana `exact` requirement: to check, before signing, that this payer can settle that exact requirement to that recipient now. Prefer another tool: For a transfer that is not an x402 requirement (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or once the payment has settled (use `/v1/solana/payment/verify`). Example: solana_x402_preflight {"asset":"2b1kV6DkPAnxd5ixfnxCpjxmKwqjjaYmCZfHsFu24GXo","amount":"1000000","pay_to":"29d2S7vB453rNYFdR5Ycwt7y9haRT5fwVwL9zTmBhfV2","payer":"6vk7icY2FzdMTzMGE4aNRSzovanAmS7xsv9uHwj4YuzY"} Paid: 0.02904 USDC or 0.0242 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.02 EUR-denominated units (approx 50 calls per bundle) or 0.024 USD-denominated units (approx 34 calls per bundle).

amount.description: Amount the requirement asks for, in the mint's base units (not UI units): a whole number of digits, at most 18446744073709551615

asset.description: Mint of the x402 requirement: the token the payment moves (base58, 32 bytes); `SOL` is not accepted, because an x402 SVM `exact` payment is always a token transfer

pay_to.description: Wallet the requirement pays (not its token account): Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

payer.description: Wallet that would pay: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

name: solana_x402_preflight
title: Solana x402 preflight
